note: Both sets capture all nine Table 5-1 values with correct bindings and supporting quotes, and neither invents anything. Set B additionally preserves the 'rated' condition on the rotor and generator speed claims, which Set A drops (only implicit in the attribute name). Both sets contain redundant rotor-speed claims (Set A one duplicate, Set B two), so B is marginally richer but slightly more repetitive; no claims in either set are misread or unsupported.
